candidates.title: Delegated aggregate authority across concurrent agents
candidates.relationship: Refine existing authority and cumulative-cost requirements.
candidates.required_behavior: Acceptance atomically reserves all maximum authorized liabilities across agents and stages; finalization, timeout and retry preserve the cumulative bound.
candidates.negative_witness: Two workers each see $10 and independently authorize $8.
candidates.proof_obligation: Prove accepted-witness soundness under explicit cryptographic, hardware, ledger and availability assumptions, plus useful valid traces; establish Midnight ZKIRv3 correspondence separately.

candidates.title: Service-payment evidence stages
candidates.relationship: Refine conditional settlement and residual-obligation requirements.
candidates.required_behavior: Specify principal-indexed authorized/reserved/executed/paid/recoverable/delivered judgments and their continuation or compensation rules.
candidates.negative_witness: Vault obtains a ciphertext key while disconnected recipient never obtains ciphertext; payment-final is incorrectly labeled delivered.
candidates.proof_obligation: Prove accepted-witness soundness under explicit cryptographic, hardware, ledger and availability assumptions, plus useful valid traces; establish Midnight ZKIRv3 correspondence separately.

candidates.title: Logical request consumption and reconciliation
candidates.relationship: Refine resource uniqueness and inspectable intent.
candidates.required_behavior: Bind request/policy/evidence identities and distinguish repeated retrieval from new execution; retries and alternate submitters reconcile the same accepted obligation.
candidates.negative_witness: A single chain nonce yields multiple irreversible service side effects, or a preempted legitimate payment is charged again.
candidates.proof_obligation: Prove accepted-witness soundness under explicit cryptographic, hardware, ledger and availability assumptions, plus useful valid traces; establish Midnight ZKIRv3 correspondence separately.

candidates.title: Federated evidence assumptions and version continuity
candidates.relationship: Refine certified lowering, privacy and evidence requirements.
candidates.required_behavior: Bind circuit, attestation measurement, committee policy and threshold to each evidence judgment; preserve residual obligations and budgets during migration and failure.
candidates.negative_witness: Valid threshold signature approves an unrelated service result; unavailable quorum is silently replaced by a weaker trust policy.
candidates.proof_obligation: Prove accepted-witness soundness under explicit cryptographic, hardware, ledger and availability assumptions, plus useful valid traces; establish Midnight ZKIRv3 correspondence separately.
